summary: @or-sdk/cards preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated in-tree payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line blob obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift routine), a >1000-entry mixed hex/string constants array, and hex-mangled identifiers. The install driver `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and per-function string-lookup objects that hide strings such as `ldd`, `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `bun`, `bun.exe`, and `powershell`. The package's advertised purpose is a `Cards` SDK re-exporting Cards types and constants from `dist/cjs/index.js`; that surface does not require fetching a second language runtime and running an obfuscated payload under it at install time. Running the payload through Bun instead of Node structurally bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
